clause: Advanced/conditional blending: Blend-If, knockout, per-channel, fill-vs-opacity [STU-RAS-041,STU-RAS-010]

scope.summary: Implement advanced/conditional blending on every layer as canonical StudioLayer fields: Blend-If sliders dropping/revealing pixels by gray or per-channel tonal ranges of this layer and the underlying composite, with split-slider feathering; knockout (shallow/deep) punching through group content; per-channel blend enablement; and interior-effects / clipped-effects / transparency-shapes-layer toggles. Include the independent Fill-opacity vs Layer-opacity fields (STU-RAS-010): fill-opacity fades pixel/fill content leaving StudioEffectStack effects at full strength; layer-opacity fades the whole layer including effects — both exposed, never collapsed.
acceptance_criteria: Blend-If (gray+per-channel, split feather), knockout shallow/deep, per-channel enable
Fill-opacity and layer-opacity independent and both exposed
expected_tests: live: Blend-If split sliders drop this-layer highlights and reveal underlying pixels with feathering; knockout-deep punches through the group; per-channel blend disable proven
live: fill-opacity fades pixels while effects stay full; layer-opacity fades layer+effects — the two differ on a snapshot

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-041]** Studio MUST provide advanced/conditional blending on every layer as canonical `StudioLayer` fields: Blend-If ranges, knockout, per-channel blend enablement, and the interior-effects / clipped-effects / transparency-shapes-layer toggles. Fill-versus-opacity ([STU-RAS-115]) is part of this advanced-blending surface.
**[STU-RAS-010]** Fill-opacity and layer-opacity are independent canonical fields; see [STU-RAS-115] for their parameter contracts.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
